title: UI polish follow-up 2: pin focus ring in document areas, palette test reads surfaces, harness cleanup catch
description: Three findings from the T076 review (agent-2f1b), none owner-visible yet: (1) in src/styles.css add '--focus-ring: 2px solid var(--accent-plain)' to the document pin rule (.writer-scroll, .manuscript-read, .preview-content) so Color never recolours focus outlines inside the document; extend src/palette.test.ts or designTokens.test.ts with an assertion for it. (2) src/palette.test.ts: read --paper, --surface, --sidebar and the selected-row surface from the CSS blocks instead of hardcoded hex. (3) scripts/native-screens.py stop_owned: also catch PermissionError (and log it) around killpg so a Color run does not exit 1 during cleanup after all PNGs were written. Checks: tsc 0; vitest palette+designTokens; the appearance spec on a private preview (quoted --outDir, one worker, no retries); for (3) run native-screens.py --palette color once against the existing smoke binary (no rebuild) -> exit 0. Protocol, serial slot, pinned Node, no installs, no commits, CLAIMED.

handoff.text: Contrast math and vitest are fine (all 5 light tints >= 4.51 on #fff/#f5f5f7/#eeeff2/#E2E3E6; vitest palette+designTokens+appearance 18 pass). But tests/appearance.spec.ts (Color palette light test, line 221) still asserts the OLD Color light values and FAILS on a private preview build: 12 passed, 1 failed at line 232 (saved check expects rgb(31,120,54), now rgb(30,116,52)). Stale expectations at lines 232,235-237,241-248,259,276 (old #0065d3 rgb(0,101,211) -> new #0062cd rgb(0,98,205); old green rgb(31,120,54) -> rgb(30,116,52); old orange rgb(153,89,0) -> #955600 rgb(149,86,0); check any warning/danger text too). Fix: update those rgb values in tests/appearance.spec.ts (add it to T085 paths via files add), rerun the spec -> 13 passed, and rerun the Playwright focus-ring/screenshot check. Note: tsc currently fails only on T080's src/import/dropImport.test.ts (missing ./dropImport), not T085.
